news.title: OpenClaw is finally available on Android and iOS
news.description: The free open source agentic program is finally invading your phone.

news.title: The DeepMind trio who built a poker AI are now making money for quant hedge funds
news.description: EquiLibre Technologies, a Prague-based AI lab founded by three ex-DeepMind researchers, is now valued at more than $500 million.

news.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
news.description: Nvidia AI chip competitor Etched says it has already booked $1 billion under contract for the inference systems powered by its chip.

news.title: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5 as a cheaper way to run agents
news.description: Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5 brings stronger agentic capabilities, lower pricing, and improved safety, positioning the model as a cheaper alternative to Opus, GPT-5.5, and Gemini Pro.

news.title: Ford rehires human engineers after AI fails to match quality checks
news.description: The car-maker found AI quality checks failed to match the skill of veteran technicians.

news.title: Tech firms are blaming AI for mega device and console price rises
news.description: Xbox consoles, Nintendo's new Switch 2 and Valve's Steam Deck are just some of the gadgets seeing price hikes in recent months.

news.title: OpenAI Has New AI Models. Here’s Why You Can’t Use Them
news.description: The White House asked OpenAI to delay the rollout of its GPT-5.6 AI models, two weeks after Anthropic had to take its most advanced AI models offline.

news.title: New attack provides one more reason why AI browsers are a bad idea
news.description: Telling an LLM that 2 + 2 = 5 is enough to make it follow forbidden instructions.
